title: Story premise ENT104: The Dragon’s Paperwork Breeze
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (fantasy and science fiction). Hook: Please complete the form without making it airborne. Takeaway/theme: Adapt the interface to the participant when possible.
description: A tiny dragon wants a library card, but every nervous snort sends the forms flying. The librarian supplies one heavy reusable slate, the dragon writes by tracing soot with a claw, and its approved first loan is a picture book about taking one quiet breath.
